To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the thickness and persistence length of dendronized polymer chains can be tuned systematically by varying the generation of the dendrons and that the theory of Boris and Rubinstein provides a simple, yet powerful, description of the scaling properties of these materials.

(i) we present a simple theory for the scaling of the persistence length and the diameter of a dendron, (ii) we present a synthesis that allows the preparation of gram amounts of high quality, dendronized polymbers of different generations with a high conversion fraction and (iii) we present AFM images that are consistent with our theory and with the synthetic results.
the synthesis of homologous dendronized polymas with systematic variation of the dendron generation is now possible, and that the theory of dendronized polymer scaling can be tested.

the synthesis and characterization of homologous polymer series of different generation dendronized polymes.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we now have a method for the production of gram amounts of dendronized polystyrene with systematic variation of X, g and N and a theoretical model for the description of their swelling and stiffness.
the synthesis of dendronized homologous series is possible and allows to test theory.
the theory and the experimental results are in qualitative agreement.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

dendronized polymes can be produced in large amounts, that the synthesis is reliable, that the polymer properties depend systematically on g and that the properties of the polymers can be predicted by a simple model.

we have demonstrated a simple, efficient, and scalable method to prepare dendronized polymes with a systematic variation of the dendron generation g and the functionality X and that the theory for the scaling of r and lambda with g and X is consistent with the experimental data.
we have demonstrated the feasibility to synthesize large samples of homologous dendronized polymbers and to measure their properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synthesis of dendronized polystyrene is now possible in gram amounts with a high conversion yield.
the synthesis and characterization of dendronized polymer samples is possible in large amounts, with high purity, and with a wide range of parameters.
the synthesis and characterization of homologous polymers with systematically varied parameters can now be done on a large scale and that the resulting data sets can be used for testing theories.
